meta.note: Values from the exported variable collections (AHS / Primitives, Colors, Typography, Spacing, Responsive) and the homepage, foundations and component PDFs; weights measured from the frames.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand/Navy. Headings and core text; inverse surface; hover and focus.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand/Blue. Emphasis and actions: primary button, links on white, accent rules, highlighted words in large type. 4.63:1 on white — text use only on white/page.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Brand/Sky. Graphic accents; highlighted words on navy (11.29:1). Never body text on white.

tokens.name: pale-blue
tokens.usage: Brand/Pale Blue. Quiet surfaces (question panel, quote card, treatment band, footer) and subtle borders.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand/White. Primary canvas and text on navy/blue.

tokens.name: muted-navy
tokens.usage: Brand/Muted Navy. Secondary text on surface-page (9.48:1) and surface-soft (8.22:1); strong borders; pressed state. On navy it is decorative only — the CTA band's topographic pattern lines (no contrast minimum applies). Never use it for text, icons or meaningful borders on navy (1.4:1); use sky or white there.

tokens.name: text-default
tokens.usage: Text/Default. Headings and body on page, soft, accent and statistic surfaces (14.15:1 on white).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Text/Muted. Secondary text, captions on page and soft surfaces (8.22:1 on pale-blue).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text/Inverse. Text on surface-inverse and on action fills.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Text/Link. Inline and action links on surface-page (4.63:1). Also used for large highlighted words (24px+ ExtraBold) inside the clinical question panel. For small links on surface-soft or surface-accent, use text-link-on-soft instead.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Text/Link-Hover. Link hover and pressed on light surfaces.

tokens.name: text-link-on-soft
tokens.usage: Added (not a Figma variable): links on surface-soft and surface-accent, e.g. footer and resource cards. Replaces blue there to pass AA (approved by Jerry).

tokens.name: text-link-on-tint
tokens.usage: Link blue for text on clinical-tint cards and white (5.69:1 on tint, 5.99:1 on white); blue #2b79b9 is 4.40:1 on the tint. InfoCard footer links, Quick Guide label text.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Text/On-Action. Button label on action-primary-* fills (4.63:1 on default).

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Surface/Soft. Question panel, quote card, treatment band, footer, resource card.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Surface/Accent. Graphic fields only; no small text other than navy.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Border/Subtle. Decorative card borders (statistic card). Not for essential boundaries.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border/Strong. Essential boundaries, partner logo tiles.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Border/Focus. 2px keyboard focus ring on light surfaces (14.15:1).

tokens.name: graphic-accent
tokens.usage: Graphic/Accent. Accent rules, evidence brackets, question bracket, quote marks.

tokens.name: graphic-quiet
tokens.usage: Graphic/Quiet. Quiet graphic fills; topographic pattern on light grounds.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Added (not a Figma variable): form errors only — error field border (2px), error message text, the "!" mark fill and the error summary title/border. 6.57:1 on white, 6.05:1 on surface-error; white on it 6.57:1. Never decorative, never for emphasis or headings.

tokens.name: surface-error
tokens.usage: Added (not a Figma variable): tinted ground of a field in error and of the form error summary. Navy text on it 13.01:1. Form errors only.

tokens.name: tag-quick-guide
tokens.usage: Format tag: Quick Guide. 4.63:1 with white. White label text (text-inverse) on it. Added (not a Figma variable) for resource format tags; the tag always names the format, so color is never the only cue. Tag set chosen to stay distinguishable under simulated deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia.

tokens.name: tag-quick-guide-text
tokens.usage: Quick Guide format label set as TEXT (resource rows): 5.69:1 on tint, 4.78:1 on sky.

tokens.name: link-spanish
tokens.usage: Added (not a Figma variable): the Spanish PDF link on bilingual resource cards (teal), so color also separates it from the navy English link. 5.79:1 on surface-soft, 6.67:1 on white; lighter than navy (2.1:1) so the pair differs in lightness. Only for that link.

tokens.name: graphic-silhouette
tokens.usage: Asset color, not a Figma variable: the fill baked into the hero silhouette PNGs. Reference only — do not use for text.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Within content groups; grid gap (desktop); card padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Radius/None. Square corners: photo fade edges, bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Radius/SM. Subtle corners: statistic cards, partner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-media
tokens.usage: Radius/Media. Consultation photo, question panel, quote card.

tokens.name: stroke-border
tokens.usage: Stroke/Border. Card and tile borders; link underline.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: Stroke/Accent. Accent rules above section headings and evidence brackets. Nov 20: 4 → 3px (lighter accents).

tokens.name: control-min-height
tokens.usage: Control/Min-Height. Minimum height of every action target (buttons, links as actions, menu toggle).

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Tracking/Display. Figma number variable, read as px. Statistic and Display (evidence) numerals.

tokens.name: accent-rule-width
tokens.usage: Measured from frames: the blue accent rule above section headings is 112 × stroke-accent.

tokens.name: hero-rule-width
tokens.usage: Measured from frames: the short rule under the hero subtitle is 100 × 3px.

tokens.name: stroke-thin-accent
tokens.usage: Thin accent: hero rule, quote card side bar, callout and question brackets, card and stat mini rules. Nov 20: 3 → 2px.

tokens.name: content-width-desktop
tokens.usage: Layout/Content/Width (desktop). Max width of the content column.

tokens.name: section-padding-desktop
tokens.usage: Section top/bottom padding (desktop). Measured from the homepage frames (80 / 40 / 24); the Figma variable Layout/Section/Padding says 80 / 56 / 40.

tokens.name: content-width-tablet
tokens.usage: Layout/Content/Width (tablet). Max width of the content column.

tokens.name: section-padding-tablet
tokens.usage: Section top/bottom padding (tablet). Measured from the homepage frames (80 / 40 / 24); the Figma variable Layout/Section/Padding says 80 / 56 / 40.

tokens.name: content-width-mobile
tokens.usage: Layout/Content/Width (mobile). Max width of the content column.

tokens.name: section-padding-mobile
tokens.usage: Section top/bottom padding (mobile). Measured from the homepage frames (80 / 40 / 24); the Figma variable Layout/Section/Padding says 80 / 56 / 40. Nov 20: 24 → 48px so sections don’t run into each other on phones (fluid 48 → 80).

tokens.name: fluid-min-width
tokens.usage: Start of the fluid range. At and below this width, fluid type and spacing sit at their *-mobile values.

tokens.name: fluid-max-width
tokens.usage: End of the fluid range. At and above this width, fluid type and spacing sit at their *-desktop values and stop growing.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Guideline check width (the 768 reference canvas). Not a layout switch: layouts are fluid. Use a media query only where something breaks.

tokens.name: breakpoint-desktop
tokens.usage: SiteHeader only: full navigation from 1024px, Menu toggle below (the four links must not wrap). Not a general layout switch.

typeDesktop.note: Maximum (guardrail) of each fluid type style, reached at 1440px. Code uses the --ja-*-size / --ja-*-lh clamp() variables in components/bundle.css.

typeTablet.note: Check values at 768px. Fluid type lands within a few px of these; not a target to hit exactly.

typeMobile.note: Minimum (guardrail) of each fluid type style, at 375px and below.
